title: BTN vs BB single-raised pot flops (postflop-solver, lean tree)

formation.name: BTN vs BB single-raised pot, 100bb (BTN opens 2.5bb, SB folds, BB calls)

provenance.ranges: BB (OOP) flat-call and BTN (IP) 2.5bb open ranges at 100bb: hand-written approximations, not solved (no preflop solve behind them).
provenance.tree: Griffin's lean Fold tree: OOP bets flop 33%/66%, turn 66%, river 50%/100%; IP bets 66% every street; raises to call + 60% pot; one raise per street; all-in when ≤ 0.2 × the pot would be left behind.
provenance.label: Approximate equilibrium of this finite game (exploitability ≤ 0.3% of the pot), not exact or universal GTO.

slicePolicy.summary: Saved slices of each full-tree solve: all flop decisions; turn and river decisions near each street's start on unraised lines for sampled cards.
slicePolicy.flop: Every flop decision node (all flop betting lines).
slicePolicy.turn: 8 turn cards per flop; turn decisions with ≤ 2 turn actions before them, on flop lines without a raise.
slicePolicy.river: 2 turn+river boards per flop; river decisions with ≤ 2 river actions before them, on flop and turn lines without a raise.
slicePolicy.omittedReach: Hands whose reach rounds to 0 at 1e-4 are omitted from a node; their total reach is recorded per node.
